programme.title: Mera Susraal
programme.desc: It is a story of Dua who marries Nadeem Ahmed out of love and enters a household where her sisters-in-law, elder and younger, engulf their lives in the greed for wealth, poisoning the happiness of Nadeem Ahmed and Dua's joy-filled life. The elder and younger sisters always assert their dominance over Nadeem Ahmed, and he, in turn, obeys their every command. In reality, both these sisters never wanted Nadeem Ahmed to marry Dua, but Nadeem Ahmed fell in love with Dua, and they got married, dreaming of starting a new life together, which remained incomplete due to the selfishness of the sisters.

programme.title: Muqaam
programme.desc: Amber and Sehar are very close friends. Amber is a simple, homely girl, while Sehar is modern, bold, and a little selfish, driven by her love for wealth. Amber gets married to Hassan, a handsome young man who believes that an ideal life partner should be modern and bold. Although Hassan marries Amber due to his family's choice, when he meets Sehar, he sees his ideal partner in her. Hassan's admiration and constant praise for Sehar greatly please her, and she completely forgets that she is crossing boundaries with her best friend's husband. Amber's simplicity and naïve nature create the space for Hassan and Sehar to grow closer, until Hassan even decides to marry Sehar as his second wife. Will Amber and Sehar's friendship turn into hatred? By rejecting Amber's love, will Hassan openly confess his love for Sehar? When respect disappears from relationships, how can anyone find their true place?

programme.title: Ishq Ek Gunah
programme.desc: Kareem, a successful businessman, lives a blissful life with his beautiful wife and grown-up children. But fate has a way of turning happiness into turmoil in a single moment. One tragic day, Kareem’s loyal driver sacrifices his life in a fatal accident while saving Kareem. Shaken and indebted, Kareem takes it upon himself to honor this ultimate sacrifice. He brings the driver’s grieving wife, Fatima, and their young daughter, Nasreen, into his own home. Nasreen, a strikingly beautiful yet ambitious young woman, is quickly captivated and consumed by the wealth and grandeur of Kareem’s household. Envy takes root, and she begins to plot her way into Kareem’s heart, weaving schemes to replace the harmony of his family with her own desires.

programme.title: Hostel
programme.desc: The story is about a girls' hostel where girls from different cities come to get an education. The hostel has strict rules and regulations, the credit for which goes to the warden of the hostel, Shaista Naz. Maha is also among the girls who came here with the dream of success in her eyes. She faces Sehar and her group, who are notorious for their mischiefs. These same things will have an impact on their future life.

programme.desc: A fascinating journey through the history of our civilization told from the perspective of six technological inventions: a car, an airplane, a smartphone, a rocket, a robot and a telescope.

programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.

programme.title: Ancient Powers
programme.desc: The creators of the six-episode series, using advanced computer graphics, will present the history of the five most powerful civilizations of antiquity: Egypt, China, India, Rome and Greece.Ancient powers have a lot in common.In the fight for survival and domination, they went through similar stages of development.They conquered new territories, built societies and political systems, as well as formed cultures, developed trade, ideas and the art of war.Viewers will learn about the latest archaeological research on ancient powers.

programme.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programme.title: Inside the Factory
programme.desc: The presenters visit the largest factories in the world and reveal the behind-the-scenes of the creation of popular products, normally inaccessible to ordinary consumers.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2
programme.desc: More than seven years have passed since the premiere of the second season of the nature super-production, but it still impresses with its great implementation.Its creators completed 125 expeditions in 39 countries over four years.They spent over six thousand hours diving in the depths and filming the coasts.The best scenes were selected from this spectacular material, taking viewers to inaccessible worlds.Their guide is Sir David Attenborough, who claims that we know less about the depths of our own planet than about the surface of Mars.The inhabitants of the ocean's depths influence our lives because they shape the climate and produce about half of the oxygen necessary for the functioning of the planet.They are also home to numerous representatives of the fauna kingdom.The development of technology has allowed man to look into their world, which was previously inaccessible.Scientists are also constantly expanding their knowledge of animal behavior.The first episode of the program is a journey through the waters surrounding the Seychelles, New Zealand, Japan and the Arctic.Filmmakers captured, among others, dolphins surfing in the Red Sea.They tracked walruses resting on melting ice in the Arctic.They followed killer whales and humpback whales feasting on herring schools in Norway.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary will present the underwater world.Viewers will have the opportunity to admire a hammerhead shark hunting its prey or a caran shark jumping out of the water into the air while hunting for a bird.

programme.title: Inside the Factory
programme.desc: The presenters visit the largest factories in the world and reveal the behind-the-scenes of the creation of popular products, normally inaccessible to ordinary consumers.

programme.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programme.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programme.title: Earth: A Year In Orbit
programme.desc: A summary of key events that occurred on Earth in 2024.The authors use satellite photos to show global crises, natural phenomena and natural disasters.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2
programme.desc: The deep ocean is as difficult to explore as space.The waters surrounding Antarctica are among the coldest on the planet.Paradoxically, in the depths, where no light reaches and the pressure seems deadly, there is an unimaginable abundance of life forms.It is assumed that in the so-called90% of all fish in the ocean live in the twilight zone.At night, huge schools of firefish swim to the surface to feed on plankton.During the day they hide again.Creatures living in the depths often resemble aliens and create stunning light shows to attract mates and deter predators.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2
programme.desc: For centuries, humanity has believed that the oceans are so vast and their inhabitants are so numerous that human activity cannot harm them.It is now known that this is not true.The existence of many animal species associated with the ocean ecosystem is at risk.This is clearly visible in the example of herring.Overfishing wiped out their population 50 years ago.Currently, thanks to good management, it has been reborn.Human-made noise, industrial pollution and plastic waste also negatively impact ocean life.In turn, more than 2/3 of the world's coral reefs have suffered from global warming.Recent research has revealed that the chemical composition of ocean waters is changing.They become acidic due to carbon dioxide dissolving in them.

programme.desc: We will meet scientists, naturalists and activists who are trying to reduce carbon dioxide emissions to ensure the optimal functioning of natural ecosystems and stop global warming.

programme.title: Wonders of the Human Body with Michael Mosley
programme.desc: Using the latest achievements in science and medicine, host Michael Mosley delves into the interior of the human body to discover its secrets.In each episode, he explores new discoveries that significantly change our perception.From the possibility of 3D printing organs to gene therapies promising to reverse blindness.Throughout the series, he provides additional information in his characteristic way, offering his body to perform groundbreaking demonstrations.Created by an award-winning team, the series is full of visuals and fascinating facts.

programme.desc: In Southeast Asia there is the so-calledThe Coral Triangle, an area containing the richest reef in the world.In this vibrant place, there is constant competition for space, food and a mate.Coral reefs, which cover less than 1/10 percent of the ocean floor, support 1/4 of known marine species.Corals create complex and diverse structures.Each reef also has a clearly marked boundary beyond which lies the ocean depth.It is a kind of wall that protects the city from waves.The reefs are inhabited by, among others:cuttlefish that prey on crabs.Although this crustacean's pincers pose a great threat, cuttlefish have an extraordinary weapon - their skin contains millions of pigment cells that create constantly changing patterns.Creatures that have adapted well to life in reefs that resemble underwater cities reap many benefits.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.

programme.title: Ancient Egypt By Train
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts goes on a long journey to get to know Egypt better.Following the paths from the book he learned in childhood, "A Thousand Leagues on the Waves of the Nile", he goes from Cairo to the Great Pyramids.

programme.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programme.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programme.title: Where the Wild Men Are UK
programme.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2: The Making of
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of the creation of a spectacular nature series that took 4 years to film.The teams implementing it visited all oceans.Thanks to the fact that the divers had the latest equipment, they could have very close encounters with the animals being filmed.Even in low light conditions, the cameras captured events invisible to the human eye.Inspection cameras show the lives of small creatures, and those equipped with a suction cup record what is happening in the ocean from the perspective of larger animals.Wanting to film the most extraordinary wildlife scenes, the team also visited coastlines in the farthest corners of the world, such as the Galapagos Islands.Marine life around these islands depends on cold currents feeding surface waters.

programme.title: Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle
programme.desc: Famous adventurer Ben Fogle interviews and meets people who have made a risky decision, leaving their life in Western society and settling in the middle of nowhere, far from civilization.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Another season of the series taking place in England, in Midsomer and its surroundings.Among the eccentric residents there are Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby (John Nettles), calm and persistent in tracking down crimes, husband Joyce (Jane Wymark) and father Cully (Laura Howard).He is assisted by his assistant, Ben Jones (Jason Hughes).Both detectives solve complicated murder cases that take place in the area.What they learn while conducting investigations sometimes exceeds their wildest expectations.

credits.actor: Detective Inspector Kieran Hussey - Bernard Curry

programme.title: Blue Lights 2
programme.desc: Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) are on duty in Belfast.They quickly discover that no training will prepare them for what they have to face - reality can be much more demanding and unpredictable.A year has passed since the dismantling of the McIntyre gang, but the vacuum left behind is immediately filled with new groups fighting for dominance.As tensions mount, the team is joined by Constable Shane Bradley (Frank Blake), whose intentions raise doubts among his colleagues.When a young loyalist begins to destabilize the fragile balance in the city, the police face the specter of a brutal confrontation.Their personal lives are equally turbulent.Tommy is considering going into intelligence more and more seriously, and Grace is struggling with missing her son and the feelings she begins to bond with one of the officers.

programme.title: Shakespeare \u0026 Hathaway: Private Investigators
programme.desc: Frank Hathaway (Mark Benton) is a private detective who constantly follows unsolved mysteries.Together with Luella Shakespeare (Jo Joyner), a hairdresser learning to be a detective, they form an unusual duo that investigates the suspicious affairs of the inhabitants of Warwickshire.However, the beginnings of cooperation are not promising.Frank has to get used to his partner's habits.Over time, they work out a compromise that is good for both sides.They will have to face the mysterious death of the mayor of Arden and must protect the safety of a certain gravedigger.The production combines elements from various British detective series.Luella Shakespeare is played by Jo Joyner, known from the cult film "Eastenders".

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. This episode comprehensively showcases the profound historical and cultural heritage of Dazu and its vibrant contemporary folk customs, exploring the thematic connotations, artistic characteristics and historical origins of the Dazu Stone Carvings, as well as their far-reaching influence on the local people for generations.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.From the world’s largest stand-alone duty-free mall – a true shopper’s paradise, to the laid-back charm of an “Old Dad Tea” restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and “mermaids” share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China’s most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang..

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang..

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters.\nThe Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow. Even in the bitter cold of around 30 degrees below zero, the grassland is alive with a festive bustle.

programme.title: Exploring the Long Winter
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Jingpo Lake, Xuexiang and Yabuli in Mudanjiang, showcasing the unique winter ice fishing festival, the fairytale-like scenery of Xuexiang, and its world-class ski resorts.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.5
programme.desc: Guangdong, sheltered by the Nanling Mountains, is a province where rivers cascade from hills on their way to the ocean. But before they meet the sea, they pass through another land of plenty, a place where solid earth encounters the rolling waves in a truly loving embrace - the Pearl River Delta.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”\nThe program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of \"maidens adorned in silver and flowers\" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it’s Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting… Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it’s all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.6
programme.desc: The mountainous realm of Fujian's centers around the Wuyi range, just opposite Taiwan Province. Join us as we trace a heritage of tea production in ancient villages, marvel at waterside Danxia, and discover terraces where seas of lotuses grow..

programme.desc: Explores agricultural modernization and innovation in China, uncovering the forces behind these transformative changes and answering the century-old question: \"Who will feed China in the 21st century?\.

programme.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.1
programme.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application?\nJoin BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: CHINA EXPANDS ZERO-TARIFF TO 53 AFRICAN NATIONS
programme.desc: Starting May 1st, China will expand preferential duty-free treatment for all imports from 53 African countries.\nCGTN host Vivienne Nunis talks to Namibian Minister of International Relations and Trade Selma Ashipala-Musavyi, Professor from Tsinghua University Tang Xiaoyang and Political Analyst Adriel Kasonta from the UK, to find out how the move will boost two-way trade between China and Africa, strengthen Africa's competitiveness in global trade and boost integrity within the continent.

programme.title: Innovation Has Its Way, Warmth Knows No Bounds
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a gala where robots take center stage? In Shanghai, a “Robot Gala” puts Chinese-made humanoid robots front and center — dancing, greeting customers, and even helping in classrooms. AI companions, from plush toys to holograms, are reshaping emotional connection in urban life. In Beijing, personalized tours led by multilingual guides help global travelers discover the Forbidden City and beyond. And in Thailand’s sugarcane fields, Chinese agricultural machinery is solving a labor crisis for local farmers. From cutting-edge technology to warm companionship, from cultural export to agricultural assistance, this episode of Meet China takes you to see how Chinese innovation unlocks a new picture of technology empowering life and cooperation promoting development.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: China's 2025 economic report card: What the data tells us
programme.desc: China's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 5% year-on-year in 2025, official data from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Monday. \nJoin CGTN's Lincoln and Vivienne in conversation with leading economists Zerlina Zeng and John Gong as they break down the figures — consumption, investment, jobs, real estate, and trade performance. As global uncertainty lingers, we'll explore how China's economy is evolving — and what the numbers reveal about policy direction and growth prospects in 2026. Don't miss out! #2025inReview #SpendingSmart #InvestChina.

programme.desc: For the third time we will have the opportunity to look at German expressways.This time, the creators of the program take us from the A2 motorway to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.

programme.desc: The crew of Syrena V8 in Nowosolna near Łódź will have to drive through the intersection of eight streets.In Łódź itself, the team will look at absurd prohibition signs on Nowogrodzka and traffic jam detours through closed streets near Strykowska.Another interesting place is Apteczna Street in Skarżysko-Kamienna, where the entry of vehicles weighing over 1.5 tons is prohibited.The absurd landscape of Polish roads also includes: a private dummy speed camera in Mniszew, a pointless bicycle path on Zawrat Street in Warsaw and a blocked road at the intersection of Miedziana and Prosta.

programme.title: Road absurdities 3
programme.desc: We will take a ride around the "absurd Bermuda Triangle" Warsaw-Łódź-Kalisz.Syrena V8 will also visit the shortest undeveloped area between Eufeminów and Jordanów.Krzysiek and Kamil will look at the senseless signs and barriers in Łódź and show the bicycle path that is the only access to one of the properties in Kalisz.Absurdity hunters will also pay attention to the narrow viaduct without a sidewalk.In Warsaw, however, they will come across parking spaces fenced off with bollards and traffic lights shining into the bushes.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers 6
programme.desc: Mike Brewer and Edd China struggle to restore a damaged car.They try to renovate and sell used vehicles of various brands at a profit.

programme.title: Misfit Garage 3
programme.desc: Mechanics from the Fired Up workshop in Dallas, Texas, specialize in restoring old, classic cars and building unique hot rods to order.The team is celebrating its first year of operation.Thanks to the experience and prestige they have gained, the guys decide to take on truly ambitious projects.One of them is the restoration of a rare 1978 Chevrolet Blazer with two-wheel drive.Additionally, Thomas has the opportunity to purchase a highly sought-after 1963 Pontiac Grand Prix.

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. programme.title: Behkaway
programme.desc: In a world where desires blur the lines between right and wrong, one man’s pursuit of happiness sets off a chain of irreversible consequences. Zubair, a middle-aged man hardened by ego and entitlement, rules over his household with an iron hand. His wife, Zeenat, bears the weight of his injustices in silence, enduring not only his coldness but the cruelty of his mother and sister. Despite her unwavering love and devotion, Zeenat receives nothing but pain in return. But everything begins to shift when Zubair encounters Sitara, a young, captivating woman whose charm ignites a dangerous spark within him. Driven by selfish desires, Zubair makes a decision that sets off a ripple effect far beyond his control. Will Zubair abandon Zeenat after meeting Sitara? Will his decision have consequences for his family? And will Sitara prove to be a blessing or a nightmare in disguise for him? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? What does life look like for Elif and Sayhaan’s father when the person they tried to protect can no longer look them in the eye? Director &

programme.desc: Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself. programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Bojh

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Dolly Darling
programme.desc: Dolly is a drama queen and an extrovert; while her husband is just the opposite, an introvert. Also her obsession and endless love for husband simply drives him nuts. But then Dolly has her own quirky talents. She is a bundle of nerves, always bubbling with boundless energy and blessed with a quick mind and a razor sharp tongue. A stylish, lively, naive and innocent Dolly does everything and goes to every extent to captivate her husband, to become his sweetheart and a darling. But at the end of the day it is not meant to be so and she fails to make an impression on her husband. So she has a smart plan She intelligently influences the people around her and the individuals in her daily life to become the star she always wanted to be for her husband, the heroine; Dolly Darling.

programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.desc: (2020) Romance starring Taylor Cole. A professional matchmaker is tasked with matchmaking a perpetually single man to boost her company's profile. Could the perfect match be right in front of them?

programme.title: Hearts in the Game
programme.desc: (2023) Romance with Erin Cahill and Marco Grazzini. Publicist Hazel is hired to rehab the image of a top baseball player. But when he turns out to be a former flame, will love be in their game plan?

programme.title: Love On Repeat
programme.desc: When Amber starts re-living the same day over and over again, she realizes she is stuck in limbo and must finally decide what it will take to make her truly happy. Starring Jen Lilley (2019)

programme.desc: Edie finds true love in London just days before she is to return to the US. They are separated, but as fate would have it, they reunite 6 years later in the US.

programme.title: Just for Showmance
programme.desc: (2023) Witty romantic comedy starring Katie McCarty. A reality TV show fakes a marriage to boost its ratings, but when off-screen sparks start to fly, love flips the script for real.

programme.title: Love, For Real
programme.desc: (2021) Rom-com with Chloe Bridges. Best friends Hayley and Bree go on a dating show to publicize her fashion brand. But with love, friendship and careers on the line it could all go wrong.

programme.desc: A mechanic and her father compete with a rival repair shop to keep their shop afloat. Starring Katherine Barrell (2024)

programme.desc: Allison Williams, a young female attorney, tries to impress her law firm partners in an attempt to make partner with her first big case.

programme.title: My Boss's Wedding
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a personal assistant plans her boss's wedding with the groom's handsome nephew.

programme.title: Rahguzar
programme.desc: Some paths are not chosen, they are lived. Rahguzar explores the delicate nature of relationships, where emotions collide with ego and silence becomes louder than words. When bonds are fragile, every decision matters. A single moment can reshape lives, turning love into distance and understanding into regret.

programme.title: Maa
programme.desc: Maa is an emotional family drama about love, loss, and identity. The story follows Raaha, a lively young girl raised by her grandfather, unaware of the painful truth about her birth. Abandoned by her mother Tara to protect her, and separated from her parents due to class differences and betrayal. Will Raaha uncover the truth about her past and find the love she was denied?

programme.title: Humnava
programme.desc: Humnava is more than just a drama it’s an emotional journey through love betrayal and resilience. It tells the story of a woman whose world is shaken when the one she trusted the most breaks her heart. But this is not just her story it reflects the pain of every person who’s ever been torn between loyalty and heartbreak. As relationships are tested and conspiracies unfold Humnava shows how real love doesn’t fade it fights it survives and it rises. Through shattered trust emotional trials and inner strength this drama is a reminder that in the end truth and sincerity always win.

Through shattered trust emotional trials and inner strength this drama is a reminder that in the end truth and sincerity always win.

programme.title: Creator
programme.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Peacemaker 2
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is an ambitious investigative journalist who, thanks to his determination, always achieves his goal.However, when one of his missions - exposing the unethical activities of the Life Foundation - turns into an obsession, Eddie loses his job and breaks up with his fiancée Anne (Michelle Williams).Weakened, he accidentally enters into a symbiosis with an alien - the fruit of the experiments of the company owner, the sinister millionaire Calton Drake (Riz Ahmed).The journalist and the alien together create a powerful and bloodthirsty monster.Eddie must find a way out of the situation before a dangerous monster takes him completely over.Meanwhile, Drake follows the reporter's trail and wants to get his property back.The comic Venom was created years ago by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane.

credits.actor: Security Chief Roland Treece - Scott Haze

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) is plagued by nightmares about her grandparents.In their dreams, they die along with other people in the Skyview skyscraper in 1969.Although such an event never happened, the girl decides to investigate the cause of her visions.To do this, he returns to his hometown, Cloverdale.She is greeted there by her father, Marty (Tinpo Lee), and younger brother, Charlie (Teo Briones).Stefani begins searching for Iris (Brec Bassinger), the grandmother she sees in her nightmares and who has broken off contact with her family.To do this, he visits his Uncle Howard (Alex Zahara) and Aunt Brenda (April Telek).Thanks to the letters found among them, he reaches a woman (Gabrielle Rose) who is dying of cancer and lives in a remote area.She tells her that the skyscraper did not collapse only thanks to her vision and earlier intervention.At the same time, he warns that from that day on, death has haunted everyone who died in the disaster, and even the descendants of the would-be victims.As she dies, her words quickly come true.Stefani wants to save her relatives from the gruesome death that inevitably awaits them.The sixth installment of the series launched in 2000.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programme.title: Creator
programme.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school students, as part of a punishment imposed by the principal, have to clean up the cluttered school basement.The collected items include an old console from the 1990s and the Jumanji game.Intrigued, the teenagers decide to activate the device.In this way, they are drawn into the virtual world.They end up in a dangerous jungle, where, as avatars, they are forced to fight for survival.Spencer becomes a brave adventurer, Fridge turns into a zoologist, Bethany becomes a corpulent paleontology professor who knows his way around maps, and Martha becomes a martial arts expert.On their way, they meet a guide who tells them the purpose of the mission.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spencer (Alex Wolff) is not feeling well at college in New York and is losing confidence again.During the Christmas break spent at home, he reaches for the console to return to the adventurous world of Jumanji.To save him, Martha (Morgan Turner), Bethany (Madison Iseman) and Fridge (Ser'Darius Blain) immediately spring into action.However, it turns out that the rules of the game have changed a lot.They cannot take on their former avatars and must switch roles.Soon, as the adventurer Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), the warrior Ruby Roundhouse (Karen Gillan), the Mouse (Kevin Hart) and the frightened Professor Sheldon Oberon (Jack Black) go deep not only into the jungle, but also into endless deserts and dangerous mountain ranges.They face many threats and a certain cunning villain (Rory McCann).Continuation of "Jumanji: Adventure in the Jungle" from 2017.

programme.title: Closer
programme.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programme.title: Another Simple Favor
programme.desc: Emily Nelson (Blake Lively), who was sentenced to 20 years in prison, regains her freedom.She is planning a wedding on the island of Capri, and an old friend becomes her bridesmaid.A crime occurs during the ceremony.

programme.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
programme.desc: The year is 1926. A slightly lost, nice Englishman, Newt Scamander, returns from an international research expedition, during which he had to find and describe as many species of fantastic animals as possible.He is carrying a mysterious suitcase with unknown contents.On the way he stops in New York.America is different from his homeland.It is forbidden to possess or transport magical creatures.Newt gets into trouble when it comes to light that his briefcase contains creatures considered dangerous.A researcher who is aware of their uniqueness does everything to ensure that they do not become extinct.Due to his inattention, several peculiar specimens find their way into the real world.Even more chaos is caused by a powerful force that threatens people's lives.Mr. Graves tries to erase the memories of people who witness her actions.The Muggle Jakub becomes involved in the course of events.Scamander must control the situation as quickly as possible and discover the source of the problem.

programme.title: By sleeping with others
programme.desc: Lainey and Jake had only slept together once, but it was the first and most important time in their lives.But then the lovers parted ways.A few years later, they accidentally bump into each other...

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: A Moldovan journalist discovers that her father, employed in Italy, is being exploited and beaten by his employer.As she investigates, she discovers that her father was also violent towards others.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean grew up in a broken home.He never planned to build a lasting relationship until he met Cindy, with whom he fell in love at first sight.When, after a few weeks of dating, it turns out that the girl is expecting another man's child, she makes the difficult decision to get married.The couple tries to create a happy family, but over time they begin to face a serious crisis.The infatuation disappears, and everyday problems make it difficult for them to find understanding.Dean abuses alcohol and does simple physical work, unable to guarantee his wife real stability and support.The couple falls into conflicts more and more often.However, he still tries to rebuild his relationships for the sake of little Frankie.This perfectly portrayed study of the breakdown of a relationship was nominated for the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival.The role of Michelle Williams was nominated for an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Some Other Woman
programme.desc: Thanks to his job, Peter Simmons (Tom Felton) has the opportunity to move to a tropical island for a few months.He takes his wife, Eva (Amanda Crew), with him there.The couple feels like they are in paradise and enjoys the charms of this beautiful place.However, duties keep Peter on the island longer, so months turn into years and Eva is forced to abandon her plans.In addition, she begins to be haunted by a mysterious woman, Renata (Ashley Greene), who looks very much like her.When Eva realizes that she is taking over her life, piece by piece, she panics.He's not going to let that happen.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programme.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
programme.desc: Agathe, a shy employee of the Shakespeare \u0026 Co. bookstore.in Paris, dreams of romantic love like in a Jane Austen novel and success as a writer.An invitation to England gives her a chance to change her fate.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: San Francisco.Will Rodman is a scientist employed by a pharmaceutical company.She is developing a formula for a drug that regenerates brain tissue that could cure his father, who suffers from Alzheimer's disease.A little chimpanzee named Caesar comes under the care of a scientist.This is where Will conducts his research.Over time, he begins to achieve success and is on the verge of a big breakthrough.He meets Caroline Aranha, who has devoted her entire life to monkeys and knows the capabilities of this species perfectly.It quickly turns out that the new drug also has side effects - it increases intelligence.Gifted with increasingly greater cognitive abilities, the chimpanzee realizes that his life means nothing to scientists.Outraged, he decides to oppose people.Caesar takes advantage of the ignorance of the facility's guards and gives samples of the drug to other chimpanzees.In a short time, all the monkeys escape from the building and start wreaking destruction in the city.The fight between intelligent monkeys for domination over humans begins.

programme.title: Hail Mary
programme.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: New York.Divorcee Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez) raises her son alone.She works as a maid at the luxurious Beresford Hotel in Manhattan.While cleaning the apartment of aristocrat Caroline Lane (Natasha Richardson), the woman tries on her elegant outfit, in which she looks exceptionally nice.Another hotel guest sees her so changed.He is lawyer Christopher Matthew (Ralph Fiennes), running for parliament.He takes Marisa as a person of a similar social status to himself.They go for a walk together and then eat dinner together.The woman cannot bring herself to correct the mistake, especially since she likes Christopher.However, it is not known how the future senator will react to the fact that his chosen one is an ordinary girl from the Bronx... The luxurious Beresford hotel, where the main character of the film works, is in fact the famous Waldorf-Astoria on Park Avenue.

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Rémi did not recover from the breakup.In order to function, he remains in a relationship with the doll Audrey, with whom he lives and shares everyday affairs.One day, a new colleague shows up at his company.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie (Katie Corwin) and Delaney (Delaney Buffett), who have known each other since childhood, are best friends.They cannot live without each other, even though each of them is at a different stage of their lives.While the first woman is ready to start a family, which was preceded by accepting the proposal of her boyfriend, John (Mason Gooding), the second one stopped at the college stage and has no intention of growing up.In addition, Delaney does not like her friend's boyfriend because she is convinced that sooner or later their relationship will suffer because of him.Therefore, Katie, who always takes into account her friend's opinion, decides to tell her about the engagement in the most delicate way possible, during a girls' trip together.Unfortunately, nothing goes according to plan during the trip.Katie Corwin and Delaney Buffett, who play the main characters, and who also co-wrote the film's script, are also considered best friends in real life.

programme.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
programme.desc: A few months after his arrest, Gellert Grindelwald manages to escape while being escorted to the Old Continent.Soon he begins to gather allies.His goal is to establish the domination of wizards over muggles throughout the world.He easily manages to convince his brethren to fight against humans.Professor Albus Dumbledore asks his former student Newt Scamander for help.So the magizoologist sets out to find Credence Barebone, who has hidden in Paris.Grindelwald is also heading there, intending to convince the boy to join him.They are followed by Tina, who is in love with a lover of unusual animals without reciprocity.Once again, Jacob Kowalski will be involved in a magical intrigue, and with him his beloved, slightly eccentric sorceress Queenie.However, the Muggle's careless behavior will put their relationship to the test.The secret hidden by the Lestrange family will also be revealed.

programme.title: Bastille Day
programme.desc: On the eve of Bastille Day, an American thief living in Paris, Michael Mason (Richard Madden), steals a bag containing a teddy bear.Not knowing that there is a bomb hidden inside the toy, he takes the money and documents and throws the rest into a trash bin in a crowded Paris metro station.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Four people die.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.

programme.title: I.S.S
programme.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.
